project_type: IoT hardware project with OpenSCAD 3D models, Python automation scripts, and ESPHome firmware
build_system: OpenSCAD CLI for STL generation, uv for Python dependency management
build_command: N/A (no formal build needed - just validate OpenSCAD syntax and Python)
verification_instructions: Verify OpenSCAD files have valid syntax, markdown is well-formed, Python deps are consistent
setup_instructions: uv venv && source .venv/bin/activate && uv pip install -r requirements.txt
environment_constraints: No internet access needed - all changes are local file edits to OpenSCAD models and documentation
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns, use uv for Python env management
key_patterns: OpenSCAD files use include <trap_modules.scad> for shared parameters. Documentation uses markdown with fenced code blocks. requirements.txt is auto-generated from requirements.in via uv pip compile.
directory_structure: 3d_models/ - OpenSCAD files; docs/ - mkdocs documentation; .github/scripts/ - automation; esphome/ - firmware configs; tests/ - pytest tests
